title: Why Is There a Metal Net in Your Microwave Door?
description:
Why is there a metal net in your microwave door? It isn't decoration. Without it, the microwaves would pour straight out through the glass.

Microwaves are waves, like light, but much longer: about 12 centimetres from crest to crest. The holes in the metal mesh are only a few millimetres wide, far too small for a wave that big, so the microwaves bounce back inside. Light waves are hundreds of thousands of times smaller, so they slip straight through. That's why you can watch your food while the microwaves stay locked in.

Ever looked closely at your microwave door?
